note: Published list prices for the hosted embedding APIs semdex can use, recorded with their source so a stale figure is visible rather than assumed current. Prices are per MILLION INPUT TOKENS in the vendor's own currency; converting them to a per-document cost needs a tokenizer, and which tokenizer is not a detail - see tokens_per_document below.

providers.unavailable_reason: No per-token or per-call API price is published on the pricing page; it lists only Model Vault instance pricing ($4.00/hour Small, $5.00/hour Medium for Embed 4). Recorded as missing rather than guessed.

tokens_per_document.note: The gap this closes warns that token counts are not comparable across tokenizers. Measured here rather than assumed: the two tokenizers available offline differ by 14 percent on the same 500 documents, so every per-document cloud figure below carries at least that band. A vendor bills on ITS OWN tokenizer, which is neither of these.
